description: This file defines a RESTful API resource class for managing User Generated Documents (UGDs) or Templates in the Fineract project. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and merging templates, and handles JSON serialization of template data. It uses JAX-RS annotations for defining REST routes and integrates with various Fineract services for business logic.

classes.name: TemplatesApiResource
classes.description: A REST resource class providing endpoints for managing User Generated Documents (Templates), supporting CRUD operations and template merging.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches all templates (UGDs), optionally filtered by type and entity.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves the data structure for creating or editing a template, useful for UI form building.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new template based on the JSON request payload.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific template by its ID.

methods.name: getTemplateByTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the template data for a specified template ID.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Updates an existing template identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: deleteTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a template by its ID.

methods.name: mergeTemplate
methods.description: Performs template merging/rendering with provided parameters and data, returning HTML output.
